'''''Heart''''' can refer to the following:

==People and places==
* [[Stone of Tear#Heart of the Stone|The Heart of the Stone]] - the room in the Stone of Tear which housed ''[[Callandor]]''.
* [[Heart]] - a cell consisting of three [[Black Ajah]] sisters.
* [[Heartsbane]] and [[Heartfang]] - other names for the Dark One.
* [[Ba'alzamon|Heart of the Dark]] - the meaning of Ba'alzamon in the Trolloc tongue.
* [[Mikel of Pure Heart]] - one of the Heroes of the Horn.

==Books and chapters==
* ''[[New Spring/Chapter 5|The Human Heart]]'' - the fifth chapter of ''[[New Spring]]''.
* ''[[The Shadow Rising/Chapter 21|Into the Heart]]'' - the twenty-first chapter of ''[[The Shadow Rising]]''.
* ''[[A Crown of Swords/Chapter 31|Mashiara]]'' - the thirty-first chapter of ''[[A Crown of Swords]]''.
* ''[[Winter's Heart]]'' - the nineth book in the ''[[Wheel of Time]]'' series.

==Terms and concepts==
* ''[[Cuendillar]]'' - meaning "heartstone" in the [[Old Tongue]].
* ''[[The Flame, the Blade and the Heart]]'' - an adventure book about several [[Heroes of the Horn]], among them [[Birgitte Silverbow]] and [[Gaidal Cain]].
* ''[[Hearts of Flame]]'' - a book of love stories.
* Milk-hearted - an [[Swearing and Insults|insult]] meaning "cowardly."
* ''Mashiara'' - "Heart of my Heart" (i.e. "my true love") in the [[Old Tongue]].
* ''Los Valdar Cuebiyari!'' - part of the battle cry of [[Manetheren]], which means "Forward the Heart Guard!" in the [[List of Old Tongue words#Notes|Old Tongue]].

==See also==
* [[Fortuona Athaem Devi Paendrag]] - who is said to have a heart-shaped face.
